Specification: This module is a small validation specification for a combinatorics library, specifically the operators factorial and choose imported from the Combinatorics module. It does not define a state machine or transition system; instead, it consists entirely of assumptions that check mathematical identities and compare imported operators against locally defined pure reference definitions. The file verifies that factorial agrees with a recursive mathematical definition on 0..12, that choose agrees with the standard factorial-based formula when n >= k on 0..12, and that choose satisfies basic boundary identities for n in 0..63.
AssumptionNames: LET T == INSTANCE TLC IN T!PrintT("CombinatoricsTests")

LET RECURSIVE factorialPure(_)
           factorialPure(n) == IF n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE n * factorialPure(n-1)
       IN \A n \in (0..12) : factorial[n] = factorialPure(n)

LET choosePure(n, k) ==
                factorial[n] \div (factorial[k] * factorial[n - k])
       IN \A n,k \in (0..12) : (n >= k) => choosePure(n, k) = choose(n, k)

\A n \in 0..63:
            /\ choose(n, 0) = 1
            /\ choose(n, n) = 1 
            /\ choose(n, 1) = n
IfThenElse: IF n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE n * factorialPure(n-1)
